verdict.rationale: Mollie's Subscriptions API schedules recurring payments and creates them automatically at the interval you specify. The Subscriptions API is also exposed through the official hosted MCP server, so an AI tool can set these schedules up. However, the scheduling covers recurring payment charges only, not general-purpose jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows beyond payment subscriptions, any workflow automation or cron-style tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
